To analyze the subtle blending issues between the organic matter (meat) and the rigid object (blade) for signs of generation artifacts.
To verify if the meat is topologically separate from the blade and if the blade's edge is sharp and continuous.

focus_areas: Realism of the ground meat texture (avoiding 'smudged' look)
Sharpness and physical correctness of the blade-meat contact line
Consistency of lighting/reflections on the steel surface
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'meat' texture. AI often generates ground meat as a uniform noisy blob rather than distinct particulate matter. Check if the meat appears to have volume and weight or if it looks like a 2D sticker. Also, evaluate the logo on the blade: if it's gibberish, it's a strong indicator of AI generation, even if subtle.
